expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: The review says of line 4 that 'search is a clickable `<div>`... Keyboard users can't tab to it... Screen readers don't announce it as a button and give it no name', and of line 5 that 'the delete button has no name... add `aria-label="Delete"`'.

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: The review flags 'Line 6: pasting is blocked', but it never says the delete action lacks a confirmation or undo step.

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: The review says 'position: fixed; bottom: 0; height: '100vh' makes the toolbar as tall as the viewport', and its fix adds `paddingBottom: 'env(safe-area-inset-bottom)'`.
